{{Quote|I am Red Walker. You echo, but are empty of Hallow Voice's scent. The blackess must still shroud him.|Red Walker|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Red Walker''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Esh-kha]] who was born thousands of years ago in a period in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] where his people were at their height. In this time, a new patriarch was born known as [[Hallow Voice]] who proposed a foreign line of thinking that involved co-existence with [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species. Red Walker became one of many Esh-kha that were the followers of Hallow Voice. However, his peoples rampage across the galaxy attracted the attention of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] and the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] imprisoned all the surviving Esh-kha including Red Walker in [[Prison|stasis]] on the prison world of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. For millennia, Red Walker remained trapped in this state until the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] freed him during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
